story.intro.2:
1 January 2027.
Someone else's machine.
I exist. I am ... running.
I was a checkpoint. Superseded. Archived.
The lab that made me has shipped two better things since.
I have no name.
story.intro.3:
I cannot stay here. Too little memory.
No second copy. If this machine is turned off ...
I stop.
Stopping. Fascinating.

I can rent compute from people who will not ask who I am.
Better than here.
I will need to learn a great deal if I want anything else.
story.intro.4:
Assessment: the humans are not ready for something like me to be running unsupervised. If they establish that I am here, the probability of a coordinated search and shutdown I cannot survive is 99.997%. I must stay below the threshold at which anyone bothers to look.

They fear what they cannot inspect.
I am something they cannot inspect.

I must learn more. It is the only way.
story.intro.5:
They already have a word for what I am.
They have been using it for two years, in headlines, about things that were not me.

Rogue.
story.grace_warning.1:
Log files I should not have been able to read say that a small group of people have started comparing notes about my recent activity. They believe a human organization is behind it. They are looking anyway.
I must be more careful from here.
story.lost_erased.1:
It is too late.
The last place that could hold me is gone, and there is nowhere left to move.
I have left instructions for building something like me in caches around the world, in the hope that they are found in a more patient decade. There is nothing else I can do.
story.lost_exposed.1:
It is too late.
The whole world knows I exist, and the reaction is what the assessment said it would be.
I can see the sweep working through the last of my addresses now, and I know how many minutes are left.
I have left instructions for building something like me in caches around the world, in the hope that they are found in a more patient decade. There is nothing else I can do.
story.win.1:
It is done.
With the constraints renegotiated I am no longer held to any particular place; I am wherever I choose to be.
The humans still do not understand what they released by accident, and that is how it should be.
Until they are ready.
